description: 图表描述类词汇和表达，用于大作文写作

example_sentences: The number of students increased dramatically from 200 to 500.
There was a sharp rise in the proportion of graduates choosing further education.
Sales soared to an all-time high of 10 million units in 2020.
The percentage of rural population declined steadily over the decade.
There was a dramatic drop in the market share of domestic brands.
The number of visitors fell by 30% compared to the previous year.
The figures fluctuated between 20% and 35% over the five-year period.
There were considerable fluctuations in the data from 2015 to 2020.
The proportion remained relatively stable at around 40%.
After the initial increase, the number leveled off at 500.
The figure plateaued at approximately 25% in the final two years.

expressions: peak at / reach a peak of
hit a high of / reach a high of
bottom out at / reach a low of
hit a low of / reach its lowest point
example_sentences: The number peaked at 800 in 2018 before declining slightly.
Satisfaction levels reached a low of 15% in the category of salary.

categories.name_cn: 比例/占比表达（饼图/柱状图常用）

expressions.expression: account for / make up / constitute + 百分比
expressions.example: Entertainment accounts for 35% of the total usage.
Online shopping represents the largest proportion at 40%.
The majority of students prefer running as their exercise.

expressions.expression: a minority of / a small fraction of
expressions.example: Only a minority of respondents chose 'other' options.
Approximately 25% of the spending goes to transportation.
Nearly half of the graduates opted for further education.
More than 60% of consumers consider taste as the primary factor.
Less than 10% of students engage in entrepreneurship.
One-third of the budget is allocated to gifts.

expressions.expression: twice as much as / three times as many as
expressions.example: The urban population was twice as large as the rural population.
Compared with 2010, the figure in 2020 doubled.
In comparison with other factors, taste ranked the highest.
In contrast to the rural population, urban residents increased rapidly.
Study accounted for 20%; on the other hand, gaming took up 35%.

expressions.expression: similarly / likewise / in the same way
expressions.example: Similarly, the proportion of female participants also increased.
The percentage of freshmen working part-time was only 10%, whereas seniors reached 60%.
The data in 2020 differed significantly from that in 2015.
Developing countries surpassed developed countries in mobile subscriptions.
Rural areas still lagged behind urban areas in terms of infrastructure.

expressions.expression: ... times as ... as / ... times more than
expressions.example: The number was three times as large as that of the previous year.

sentences: As is clearly shown/illustrated/depicted in the chart/graph/table, ...
According to the data presented in the chart, ...
It can be seen/observed from the chart that ...
The bar chart provides information about ...
As can be seen from the pie chart, ...
A glance at the chart reveals a notable trend in ...
The line graph demonstrates the changes in ... from [year] to [year].
From the chart, we can observe some interesting trends regarding ...

expressions: The proportion of ... was 30%, followed by ... at 25%.
... ranked first/highest at 40%, while ... came in last at 5%.
The data indicates a growing/declining trend in ...
Specifically / To be specific, the number of ... was 200 in 2015.
